editorial.description_en: Winter branches against a pale sky: a dark neutral brown that carries almost no red.
editorial.description_ja: 冬の枯れた枝のような、暗く落ち着いた茶。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.428, C 0.056, h 62.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 枯れ (kare, withered) + 枝 (eda, branch). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Bare Branch" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 枯枝. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — do-ma at ΔE00 4.1, furu-kawa at ΔE00 7.2, furu-gawara at ΔE00 9.3. complementary is the entry nearest the opposite OKLCh hue (242°), within 22°. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
